office_does: A Whatcom PUD commissioner sits on the three-member board of the county-wide public utility, which supplies industrial water and electricity and builds broadband; the board sets rates and policy and serves six-year terms.
race_blurb: All Whatcom County voters elect the District 1 seat, and there was no primary. Commission President Eddy Ury, elected in 2024 to finish the term, seeks a full six-year term. His opponent, Frank Imhof, submitted no statement, and the PDC lists his campaign as discontinued, though his name stays on the ballot.

candidates.summary: Incumbent District 1 commissioner and 2026 commission president, elected in 2024 to a two-year unexpired term, with a background in nonprofit clean-energy policy.
highlights: Won the 2024 special election with 59.3% in the late count [S4]
Says the commission approved a non-potable water plant, transmission lines and a substation [S1]
Pledges to keep the PUD from levying taxes [S1]
Pledges to sustain freshwater supplies for farms, fisheries, industries and households [S1]

candidates.summary: On the ballot but submitted no voters'-guide statement; the PDC has listed his campaign as discontinued since May 15, 2026.
highlights: PDC status: "Candidate discontinued campaign," no reports filed [S3]
Filing email is at the domain of IMCO Construction, which lists a Frank Imhof as a founder [S2][S5]
